messages:
From: Alex Romero <alex.romero@greenwave.com>

Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@greenwave.com>, it-admin@greenwave.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC interest — scheduling kickoff?

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. GreenWave is keen to move forward with a short POC focused on routing/latency for our multi-tenant prompt pipelines and a couple of load scenarios. We want the kickoff to be hands-on — prompt review, routing policy tests, and a small load run to validate token cost estimates.

Can we target a 90-minute working session the week of Feb 16th? Our preliminary availability: Tue 2/17 (10:00–12:00 PT) or Thu 2/19 (13:00–15:00 PT).

Two quick asks so your team can prep:
- Staging endpoint(s) + temporary API key(s) or sandbox account.
- VPC/IP allowlist details for our IT team so they can open outbound access.
- A short test-data checklist (we can provide a sanitized subset).

Jordan (cc) is our infra lead and will coordinate the allowlist.

Cheers,
Alex Romero
Senior Product Manager | GreenWave Analytics

Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@greenwave.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC interest — scheduling kickoff?

Alex —

Great to hear — excited to run this. Either slot works for us but proposing Thu 2/19 13:00–14:30 PT (75 minutes) to keep it focused. If that’s tight for GreenWave we can go 90 minutes.

Draft agenda (can adjust):
1) 10 min intros + success criteria
2) 25 min prompt architecture & routing review (we’ll pull a couple example prompts)
3) 25 min hands-on routing + KV/prefix caching demo
4) 20–30 min small load test (aim for 50 concurrent users equivalent) + throughput/latency review

For env prep, we’ll need the following from your side at least 48 hours before the session:
- IP(s) to add to our staging allowlist (or, if you prefer, a VPC peering request)
- A point of contact who can spin up any internal test accounts and share sanitized test data (S3 or CSV link)
- Confirmation if you need us to provision a dedicated pool for the load run (this has a short lead time)

I’ve attached a short runbook we use for POCs (POC-runbook-v1.docx) — it outlines timelines for API key issuance and the allowlist window.

If 2/19 works, I’ll send calendar invites and loop in our solutions engineer (Sean Gallagher) and Prio (Prriyom Das) to own the hands-on sections.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Team — forwarding GreenWave’s note and our proposed 2/19 slot. Can one of you take lead on the hands-on run and load test? Quick checklist below: 

- Who will drive prompt/review + routing demo? (Sean preferred)
- Prio, can you prepare the small load harness and confirm if we need a short Dedicated reservation for the 20–30 minute run (expected ~50 concurrent eq.)?
- Infra: we’ll need staging endpoint(s) + sandbox API key creation, and a temporary IP allowlist window (48–72 hrs). I’ve attached the runbook for reference.

Notes: GreenWave might supply sanitized S3 test data. If they don’t, we’ll generate synthetic input to match their token distribution.

Sean — take the lead on the sample prompts; I’ll handle the kickoff and success criteria. Also, flag any quotas or VM reservations you need with infra.

Thanks —
Marissa
